probe_gatt.name: Probe GATT (development only)
probe_gatt.description: Development-only. With FORA 6 CONNECT visibly current in Advertisement Monitor, connect through Home Assistant Bluetooth and list GATT metadata without characteristic I/O.

address.name: Bluetooth address (private)
address.description: Development-only. Copy the Bluetooth address for FORA 6 CONNECT from Settings → Connectivity → Bluetooth → Advertisement Monitor. It is used only in memory for this probe and is not returned or persisted. Do not share it publicly.

observe_notifications.name: Observe notifications (development only)
observe_notifications.description: Stage 1C only. Subscribe to three known Notify characteristics for 30 seconds and return counts and lengths without raw payloads. Bleak may configure CCCDs; no application characteristic read or write is sent.

address.name: Bluetooth address (private)
address.description: Copy the known FORA 6 CONNECT address privately from Advertisement Monitor. Used only in memory; never returned, logged, or persisted. Do not share it publicly.

probe_protocol_identity.name: Probe protocol identity (development only)
probe_protocol_identity.description: Stage 2E only. Subscribe to custom 1524, send the captured wake and project queries once each with write response, validate project 0x4183, then unsubscribe and disconnect. No records are requested.

address.name: Bluetooth address (private)
address.description: Copy the known FORA 6 CONNECT address privately from Advertisement Monitor. Used only in memory; never returned, logged, or persisted. Do not share it publicly.

probe_protocol_record.name: Probe first stored record (development only)
probe_protocol_record.description: Stage 2F only. Confirm GD82 identity, then query current-user record slots and raw index zero through custom 1524. Returns status only. No clock setting, pairing, or production sync.

address.name: Bluetooth address (private)
address.description: Copy the known FORA 6 CONNECT address privately from Advertisement Monitor. Used only in memory; never returned, logged, or persisted. Do not share it publicly.
